text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 1. Lens 1 cell = malicious transaction reverted with the documented expected reason of the named defence, with a differential control that the authorized

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: action succeeds. '—' = structurally N/A for that standard's model (11 cells).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 2. Lens 2 legend: D defended · P partial · V vulnerable · N n/a; * = reasoned from the verified source (structural absence), others executed. Sybil cost

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 3. Reading: no column is all-D in Lens 2 — no standard dominates (H5). Recovery is ERC-4337's alone; soulbound theft resistance is ERC-1155's; on-chain VIN
